mechanics.rationale: Cutting cedar adds logs to the logger's represented stock; no source reserve is represented, so no reserve is consumed.
limits: This action adds one log per use because no cutting quantity is specified.
No unrepresented tree reserve is checked or depleted.
tests: A logger gains one log.
An actor with a different role cannot cut cedar.
semantic_bindings: add logs to the logger's stock

mechanics.rationale: Sawing consumes one log from the named source and adds one slat to the sawmill operator's stock.
limits: One log makes one slat; no larger conversion rate is represented.
The named source must have inventory and be in the same place as the sawmill.
tests: With a nearby source holding a log, the sawmill consumes one log and gains one slat.
The action is refused if the source is elsewhere or has no logs.

mechanics.rationale: Mining adds graphite and clay to the miner's represented stock; no mine reserve is represented.
limits: One unit of each material is added per use because no quantity is specified.
No unrepresented mine reserve is checked or depleted.
tests: A miner gains one graphite and one clay.
An actor with a different role cannot mine materials.
semantic_bindings: add them to the miner's stock

mechanics.rationale: Making leads consumes one graphite and one clay from the named source and adds one lead to the lead maker's stock.
limits: One unit of graphite and clay makes one lead; no other conversion rate is represented.
The named source must be nearby and hold both materials.
tests: With nearby graphite and clay, the lead maker consumes one of each and gains one lead.
The action is refused if either material is missing.
semantic_bindings: graphite and clay from the named source

mechanics.rationale: Supplying slats transfers one slat from the named source into the factory's stock.

checks.label: the worker is at the pencil factory

limits: One slat is transferred per use because no quantity is specified.
Only a nearby source holding a slat can supply it.
tests: A nearby source loses one slat as the factory gains one.
The action is refused when the source has no slats.
semantic_bindings: pass slats to the pencil factory

mechanics.rationale: Supplying leads transfers one lead from the named source into the factory's stock.

checks.label: the worker is at the pencil factory

limits: One lead is transferred per use because no quantity is specified.
Only a nearby source holding a lead can supply it.
tests: A nearby source loses one lead as the factory gains one.
The action is refused when the source has no leads.
semantic_bindings: pass leads to the pencil factory

mechanics.rationale: Assembly consumes one slat, one lead, one paint, one eraser, and one ferrule, producing one pencil.
limits: One pencil is assembled per use.
No paint, erasers, or ferrules are supplied by this action.
tests: With all five required inputs, the factory consumes one of each and gains one pencil.
Assembly is refused if any required input is absent.
semantic_bindings: apply paint, erasers, and brass ferrules

mechanics.rationale: Packing converts the requested number of factory pencils into the same number of boxes; the represented state has no pencils-per-box ratio, so one pencil per box is used conservatively.

checks.label: the worker is at the pencil factory

limits: Accepted quantities are 1 through 8.
The represented world does not specify how many pencils fit in a box; this mechanic uses one pencil per box.
No packaging-material stock is represented or consumed.
tests: Packing two available pencils removes two pencils and adds two boxes.
Packing is refused for a nonpositive, unsupported, or unaffordable quantity.

mechanics.rationale: Loading transfers the requested boxes from the named source's inventory into the truck's represented box stock.
limits: Accepted quantities are 1 through 8.
The source must be an actor with inventory in the truck driver's location.
No truck capacity is represented.
tests: Loading two boxes from a nearby source transfers two boxes to the truck.
Loading is refused if the source is distant or lacks enough boxes.

mechanics.rationale: Delivery transfers boxes from the truck into the named shop and records the stated journey duration as rounds remaining.

checks.label: the truck is at the box source
the shop is the named destination
the truck has boxes to deliver

limits: This transfers one box per use because no delivery quantity field is available.
The destination must resolve to a shop and the box source to a truck.
The represented state does not specify route feasibility or automatic travel completion; this action records rounds remaining but does not move locations.
tests: A truck with a box can deliver one box to a named shop and set the journey rounds.
Delivery is refused if the truck has no boxes, the destination is not a shop, or rounds are not positive.

mechanics.rationale: A sale transfers the requested pencils from shop stock to the customer, charges the listed price per pencil, and credits the shop.

checks.label: the customer can pay the listed price

limits: Accepted quantities are 1 through 8.

The represented price is applied once per sale because no multiplication expression is available; quantity greater than one is refused by this conservative pricing interpretation only if the customer cannot cover the listed price.
No waiting-order or renewed-demand state is represented.
tests: A nearby customer with sufficient cash can buy when the shop has stock.
A sale is refused if the customer is distant, the shop lacks stock, or the customer cannot pay the listed price.

mechanics.rationale: Movement sets the acting entity's location to the named destination only when the named passable route connects the actor's current location to that destination in the declared forward direction.

checks.label: the route begins where the traveler is
the route ends at the named place

limits: Only the route's place_a to place_b direction is supported; reverse travel is refused unless represented by a route with reversed endpoints.
No travel duration or cargo movement is represented by this action.
tests: An actor at a passable route's first place can move to its second place.
Movement is refused for an impassable route, mismatched start, mismatched destination, or reverse direction.
semantic_bindings: by way of the named route
